description: Reads the folder tree of one game, one line per folder (path and id), with each folder's events: name, id, ✓ when a sound is chosen, duration and loop, and for a Music track the settings saved in its form (mode, quality, genre, bpm, key, beats per bar, sung or instrumental). Entities inside a folder inherit its events. Read-only, costs nothing. Use it to find a folder_id or parent_id before create_folder, create_event, create_entity or move_entities, and to see Ambience, Interface and Music sounds, which live in folders. For the entities themselves use get_game.

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.

title: Game folders
